Problem: All closures capture the same var binding, so every callback returns the final value
Explanation: var is function-scoped, so a single i exists for the whole loop. By the time the stored callbacks run, i has reached 3 and all three return 3 instead of 0, 1, 2.
Suggested Fix: Use let, which creates a new binding per iteration: for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
